curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Cover how towing changes speeding up, stopping, passing and turning, then the trailer size limits, lights, plates, safety chains, mirror width and brake rule.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: One card per towing rule and limit, with a contrast card for trailer size versus mirror width.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz describing a trailer and asking whether it meets the rules.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Explain who may drive a recreational vehicle combination, its length and metro rush-hour limits, motor home and single-unit lengths, the width rule and what the trailer may carry.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards for each recreational vehicle rule, with a contrast card comparing the length limits.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz on recreational vehicle age, length and timing rules.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Cover preparing the vehicle, getting the feel of the road, rocking out of snow, sharing the road with snowplows and snow emergency parking.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: One card per winter rule, with a contrast card for rocking the vehicle versus spinning the tires.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz on winter preparation and passing snowplows.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Explain the winter survival kit, why you stay with a stranded vehicle, running the engine safely, signaling for help, staying awake, and how to handle fatigue on long drives.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards for each stranded and fatigue rule, with a contrast card for the ten-minute rule versus the two-hour rule.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz on what to do when stranded or tired.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Cover handling skids, braking with anti-lock brakes, driving in storms and fog, and what hydroplaning is, when it happens and how to respond.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: One card per rule, with contrast cards for slower versus faster speeds on wet roads.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz on skids, anti-lock brakes and hydroplaning.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Explain warning signs and responses for blowouts, steering failure and brake failure, downshifting to slow, drifting onto the shoulder, and coasting downhill.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: One card per failure and response, with a contrast card for pumping regular brakes versus pressing anti-lock brakes.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz describing a vehicle failure and asking what to do.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Cover deer, vehicles in your lane, failed passers, narrow roads, stalls on railroad tracks, flooded roads and escaping a vehicle in deep water.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: One card per hazard response, with contrast cards for moving right versus left and for the flood water depths.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz describing a road hazard and asking the safest response.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Explain headlight, wiper and hood failures, engine fires and overheating, a stuck gas pedal, crashes into power equipment, and how to recognize and prevent carbon monoxide poisoning.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: One card per equipment emergency and carbon monoxide rule, with a contrast card for staying in versus leaving a vehicle touching power lines.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz describing an equipment emergency and asking the right step.
